Here are 60 customer feedback comments from our last NPS survey (pasted below). Can you group them into MECE categories and tell me which ones are ambiguous between groups?

1. The per-seat price is too high for a team our size.
2. Pricing is fair compared to what we paid for the old tool.
3. I wish there was a cheaper plan without the advanced reports.
4. Annual billing saved us money, but the monthly option feels expensive.
5. We got hit with an overage charge we did not expect.
6. Great value for what you get.
7. The jump from the Basic plan to Business is too steep.
8. Please add a discount for non-profits.
9. Setup took us three weeks, much longer than promised.
10. The onboarding checklist made getting started easy.
11. I could not figure out how to import my old data.
12. The welcome emails were helpful, but there were too many of them.
13. We needed a live walkthrough; the docs were not enough.
14. Getting my team invited was painless.
15. The tutorial skipped the part I actually needed.
16. Our onboarding specialist was fantastic.
17. Support replied within an hour and solved it.
18. I waited four days for an answer to a simple question.
19. The chatbot kept sending me to articles that did not help.
20. Our account manager really understands our business.
21. Support is only available during US hours, which is hard for us in Asia.
22. Every time I contact support I have to explain the issue again.
23. Phone support would be great.
24. The agent was friendly but could not fix the problem.
25. The dashboard takes forever to load when I filter by date.
26. Exports with more than 10,000 rows time out.
27. It is fast, even with our large data set.
28. The mobile app is slow on my older phone.
29. Search results take several seconds to show up.
30. Reports run overnight now, which is a big improvement.
31. The page freezes when I open the settings tab.
32. I need a way to schedule reports automatically.
33. The custom fields feature is exactly what we needed.
34. There is no way to bulk edit records.
35. Please add a dark mode.
36. We still can not set different permissions per project.
37. The new approval workflow saves us hours every week.
38. I miss the old calendar view.
39. Would love to see a public API for our developers.
40. The interface is clean and easy to understand.
41. Too many clicks are needed to do a simple task.
42. The menu names are confusing; I never know where to find things.
43. The new layout is much better than the old one.
44. Buttons are too small on tablets.
45. I keep losing my place when the page reloads.
46. Colors make the charts hard to read.
47. The Slack integration works perfectly.
48. It does not connect with our accounting software.
49. The Salesforce sync breaks every few weeks.
50. Zapier support is a lifesaver.
51. We had to build our own connector for Google Sheets.
52. Single sign-on setup was straightforward.
53. Importing from Excel keeps mangling date formats.
54. There was an outage during our busiest day of the quarter.
55. No downtime in a year, very stable.
56. Data disappeared after the last update and support had to restore it.
57. Notifications sometimes arrive hours late.
58. Scheduled jobs failed twice this month without any warning.
59. The status page is helpful when something goes wrong.
60. Sync errors happen more often than I would like.
